phrase.zh: 从不同的食物中，寻找恢复的线索。
phrase.en: Look among different foods for a clue to recovery.

visual.zh: 肝脏形体在左侧宽阔，向右收窄并越出画面；一条浅沟分开两叶，细排线顺着体积延伸，底部阴影衬出轮廓。
visual.en: A liver form is broad at the left and tapers beyond the right edge. A shallow seam distinguishes the two lobes, while fine hatching follows their volume and a shadow beneath defines the outline.

background.zh:
惠普尔与迈诺特、墨菲共同获得1934年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。惠普尔研究失血后的血液再生，比较不同食物在动物研究中的作用，其中肝脏带来的结果启发了后续临床研究。肝脏形体取意于这段研究，是原创插画，不是解剖图或饮食处方；历史肝脏疗法不代表今天的治疗方法。短句为原创。
1934年生理学或医学奖；获得本年度奖项的三分之一。获奖理由（中文译述）：关于以肝脏疗法治疗贫血的发现。
background.en:
Whipple shared the 1934 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Minot and Murphy. He studied blood regeneration after blood loss, comparing foods in animal research; the findings involving liver inspired later clinical work. The liver form draws on that history. It is original artwork, not an anatomical diagram or a dietary prescription; historical liver therapy does not represent present-day treatment. The phrase is original.
1934 — The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Received one-third of the prize. Official motivation: for their discoveries concerning liver therapy in cases of anaemia
